caption: The drawing depicts three objects arranged on a plain, off-white background. The top left object is a hatchet or cleaver-like tool with a wide, slightly curved, rusty brown metal blade and a short handle with a metallic band at its base. Below and slightly to the left is a large knife with a broad, rectangular, rusty brown blade and a wooden handle affixed with two brass-colored rivets. To the right of both is a long-handled skimmer with a round, flat, perforated metal bowl at the bottom and a handle made from the same brown metal that ends with a hooked tip. The objects are illustrated in naturalistic colors, highlighting shades of brown, rust, and metallic tones.
title: Sugar Industry Implements
